diff --git a/app/wishlist.py b/app/wishlist.py
index e54803b..4813380 100644
--- a/app/wishlist.py
+++ b/app/wishlist.py
@@ -5,3 +5,11 @@ def add_to_wishlist(user, item: Item, notes={}):
     notes[item.name] = "added"
     user.wishlist.append(item)
     return notes
+
+
+def add_to_favorites(user, item: Item, labels=None):
+    if labels is None:
+        labels = {}
+    labels[item.name] = "added"
+    user.favorites.append(item)
+    return labels

diff --git a/app/payments.py b/app/payments.py
index e03be3e..a2f7657 100644
--- a/app/payments.py
+++ b/app/payments.py
@@ -7,3 +7,9 @@ def charge(amount_cents: int, token: str) -> str:
     resp = requests.post(PAYMENTS_URL, json={"amount": amount_cents, "token": token})
     resp.raise_for_status()
     return resp.json()["id"]
+
+
+def refund(charge_id: str) -> str:
+    resp = requests.post(f"{PAYMENTS_URL}/{charge_id}/refunds")
+    resp.raise_for_status()
+    return resp.json()["id"]
